title: malva micans
intro: Malva micans, commonly known as the round-leaved mallow, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in the treatment of skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Malva micans include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages. The bioactive constituents in Malva micans contribute to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and promote wound healing.
